_scoring.method: blind list saved to /tmp/auditA/blind.txt before opening stored records; class rules run with python over data/duties/*.json + data/powers/*.json (9 sessions, 22794 records) and data/dropped/*.json (1897 dropped)

_classes.name: local assessor stored under group 'Assessors (local)' instead of the locality
title or application phrase parsed into agency_unit as a junk locality
_classes.rule: ';' in agency_unit and re.search(r'\b(for|to|from) (a|an|the) |Exemption|Application', agency_unit, re.I)

_classes.name: local-option exemption authorization (town/county may adopt a local law) dropped as an exemption
_classes.rule: dropped rule startswith 'exemption' and quote ~ r'authorized to adopt a local law|may,? by local law|by resolution, exempt|may adopt a local law'

_classes.name: 'as may be prescribed by' form authority stored as a duty
_classes.rule: kind == 'duty' and quote ~ r'as may be prescribed by|as may be required by' (over-matches where the sentence also imposes a duty; review hits)

_classes.name: quote truncated at a line wrap of appropriation-table text (ends on a function word)
_classes.rule: quote.strip() ~ r'\b(the|of|to|and|a|an|for|by|that|such|in)$' (143 all laws; 9 where law_title ~ appropriat|budget)

_classes.name: extends_existing true on wholly new matter inside a replaced appropriation item
_classes.rule: no mechanical rule (needs judgment of whether the braced text replaces or widens)

_classes.name: sunset extension missed when the title names a private beneficiary but the act names the State actor
_classes.rule: no mechanical rule; candidate: laws with zero records whose text contains 'deemed repealed' with braced date and an act section naming 'dormitory authority'

2021-S6469-05.quote: Upon receipt of such proposal, the town board shall convey the proposal to the conservation board of such town.
